# ClipMotion

> ClipMotion is an AI video ad generator that turns SaaS and app landing pages or e-commerce product pages into short video ads with scripts, voice-over, captions, and music.

- Input: a public SaaS, app or product landing page.
- Output: editable MP4 video ads in 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9.
- [Homepage](https://clipmotion.ai/)
- [Pricing and export options](https://clipmotion.ai/pricing)
- [FAQ](https://clipmotion.ai/faq)
- [Sitemap](https://clipmotion.ai/sitemap.xml)
